integrity: Backward Kolmogorov equations and outgoing-state conditions provide the analytic proof.

scientific_limitations: One inward-started persistent particle with constant speed, continuous nonnegative position-dependent reversal intensity, and two perfectly absorbing boundaries.
No Brownian diffusion, partially reflecting boundaries, velocity asymmetry, or waiting states.

title: Sharp joint exit-probability and mean-time region for spatially heterogeneous persistent transport
